parsed.post: New personal best (0.996664) achieved by stacking TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144 onto the DEPTH=6/MATRIX_LR=0.02 stack. This confirms that the capacity gains from DEPTH=6 help stabilize the lower learning rate at high batch sizes. Next: probing WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to see if a longer warmup further improves this low-LR configuration.
parsed.description: Probing WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 -> 0.1 on the current best configuration (DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.02, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144) to see if longer warmup helps stabilize the lower learning rate.
